name: sentry
description: Official MCP server hosted by Sentry at mcp.sentry.dev. Zero install for sentry.io users — connects over Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Exposes issues, errors, projects, and Seer crash-analysis tools.
setup: First connection prompts an OAuth flow through Sentry — log in and grant access to your org.
During auth you select which tool groups to expose; keep the surface focused on what your project actually uses to save context tokens.
Self-hosted Sentry instances use the stdio transport with a personal access token — see the homepage docs. This recipe targets the cloud (sentry.io) endpoint.
If your MCP client doesn't yet support hosted/HTTP servers, install the `mcp-remote` shim per the Sentry docs.
